title: Epiphone Masterbilt Frontier, Iced Tea Aged Gloss

long_description.title: A Rare Epiphone Classic Joins the Masterbilt Family
long_description.body:
The Masterbilt™ Collection presents a recreation of the rare 60s-era Epiphone Frontier. Featuring a square-shouldered body with solid maple back and sides, a solid Sitka spruce top with the iconic “Rope and Cactus” pickguard, bone nut and saddle, and the state-of-the-art Fishman® Presys VT™ onboard preamp system for true acoustic tone when plugged in. Available in Ice Tea Aged Gloss finish. Featuring Gibson™ Strings. Epiphone stands behind every guitar they make with a Limited Lifetime Warranty and Gibson Brands™ Customer Service.

A battery is not included. To power your pickup, you will need a 9-volt battery.

Electronics Specs.Controls: Fishman® Presys VT™ Soundhole mounted Volume and Tone

Misc Specs.Case: Optional Acoustic AJ/Dreadnought Hard Case 940-EDREAD; Dread/AJ Acoustic EpiLite™ Case 940-EDREADHG
Misc Specs.Strings Gauge: Gibson™ Phosphor Bronze Acoustic Guitar Strings .012, .016, .024w, .032 .042, .053
